tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently started a part-time job at a local bookstore. Your manager, Ms. Patel, has been helpful in guiding you through your responsibilities. However, you are finding it difficult to balance your work schedule with your academic commitments and need to discuss a possible change in your work hours. Write an email to Ms. Patel.
bullets: Thank her for the support and guidance she has provided since you started the job.
Explain why you are having difficulty balancing your work and academic commitments.
Request a meeting to discuss adjusting your work hours to better fit your schedule.
tasks.subject: Request to discuss work schedule adjustment
